    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):

    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"), (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"), (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
    return (keep_mask, margin)"
}
